WITH spatial_projects AS (
  SELECT 
    p.fundflux,
    sp.boxy,
    sp.boxx,
    sp.aream2,
    sp.volm3
  FROM scanspatial sp
  JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
  WHERE sp.boxy IS NOT NULL 
    AND sp.boxx IS NOT NULL 
    AND sp.boxx != 0
    AND sp.aream2 IS NOT NULL 
    AND sp.volm3 IS NOT NULL
    AND sp.volm3 != 0
),
funding_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    AVG((boxy - boxx) / boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x_diff,
    AVG(aream2 / volm3) AS area_volume_ratio
  FROM spatial_projects
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(area_volume_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio
  FROM funding_stats
)
SELECT 
  fs.fundflux,
  fs.avg_y_vs_x_diff,
  fs.area_volume_ratio,
  fs.area_volume_ratio - oa.overall_avg_ratio AS above_average
FROM funding_stats fs
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE fs.area_volume_ratio > oa.overall_avg_ratio
ORDER BY fs.area_volume_ratio DESC;
